audit_scope: Thor adaptation review only; no production source changes in this review
resolved_deployment_issue: Latest cloned source was not the package used by service override; actual venv updated to source commit ca690bdf and service restarted under prior explicit authorization. This is separate from remaining Thor adaptation gaps.

evidence: Thor raw frames captured in thor-raw-tegrastats.txt have no GPU utilization token
thor-nvml-probe.json successfully returns NVIDIA Thor utilization via existing pynvml
findings.impact: GPU utilization absent in service payload and all TTO features
findings.proposal: Keep tegrastats for existing Orin. Add Thor NVML GPU utilization with explicit percent field, separate clock units, provider and sample time. Attach an immutable sampled GPU value when committing a new telemetry sample; never change GPU payload under the same stream_id/sample_seq. Failure or stale provider is missing, not zero. TTO reads new field with provider/time qualification; retain legacy Orin compatibility. Identify platform from device-tree compatible (verified Thor nvidia,tegra264), record capabilities, and publish platform/provider identity for TTO; do not rely on hostname or user manual platform selection.
findings.acceptance: Controlled existing user workload: compare NVML and service at aligned times; distinguish missing from zero; cached retransmits do not trigger identity_conflict; provider failure does not stop TJ collection.

evidence: power_current_rails config exists but is not used by numbers()
findings.impact: Two real Thor rails are retained raw but omitted from features
findings.proposal: Define explicit Thor feature columns for the real rail identities and W conversion; keep raw mW/current/average. Do not alias Thor combined rails to Orin rails or add them into an invented total. Keep Orin profile.
findings.acceptance: Recorded-frame replay exactly converts mW to W for each named rail; unknown rails remain in raw data; no RAM/SWAP power entries; changed profile rejects incompatible frozen models.

evidence: Thor provides soc012,soc345; TTO looks for soc0,soc1,soc2
TJ/CPU/GPU temperatures already preserved and consumed
findings.impact: Two measured grouped sensors are omitted from features
findings.proposal: Add Thor grouped sensor feature names with their actual meaning. Do not split one grouped reading into invented individual SoC sensors. Preserve current TJ target.
findings.acceptance: Recorded-frame replay preserves exact grouped values; missing stays missing; CPU/GPU/TJ extraction unchanged.

evidence: All 38 prediction origins normal_auto=false, duty/gain unavailable
Firmware AUTO adaptive and CURVE hysteresis are separate branches
findings.impact: This round can verify raw acquisition and produce baseline references, but cannot train/evaluate under current normal-AUTO contract
findings.proposal: User requires current motherboard-controlled CURVE mode. Add explicit CURVE eligibility while keeping AUTO classification separate. Use valid successful duty and history for CURVE; controller_gain is AUTO-specific in examined firmware and must not remain a mandatory CURVE feature. Keep manual/fault/stale exclusions and scope-change boundaries. Do not change motherboard mode.
findings.acceptance: AUTO/CURVE/manual/fault/stale fixtures classify correctly; scope changes create boundaries; saved baseline remains immutable.

evidence: Current feature_schema=1 and ALL_COLUMNS count is 54
Adding two Thor power groups and two temperature groups naively adds 12 columns and exceeds the hard 64-column limit
Dataset checks common source period; model gates do not explicitly identify hardware profile
findings.impact: Naive field addition can break feature dimension and permit unsuitable platform/control-scope mixing
findings.proposal: Small explicit Orin and Thor feature profiles with source/platform identity carried through run, dataset and frozen model. Define schema migration and reject incompatible model/profile combinations. Select per-platform groups, do not blindly append a global union or arbitrarily increase the limit.
findings.acceptance: Each supported profile fits the declared limit; legacy profile behavior preserved; cross-profile model use and unintended dataset mixing rejected.

evidence: Report conclusion says software usable and suggests split/evaluate although normal_auto_origins=0
host_scope hardcoded current_host_only_not_N305 while actual observer is verified N305
Current provenance deployment_unverified; no firmware installation identity independently verified
findings.impact: Acquisition success can be mistaken for evaluation readiness; host and deployment qualification incomplete
findings.proposal: Report connection/usable measurements separately from feature coverage/control-scope eligibility/model readiness. Record evidenced host/platform and package identity; keep firmware/deployment evidence gaps explicit. Tailor next step to actual blockers.
findings.acceptance: This preserved run clearly reports accepted TJ data, missing optional inputs, CURVE exclusion and no model-validation claim; current-host proof does not imply other-device or firmware qualification.

implementation_order: Confirm control-scope acceptance and small explicit platform input contract
Adapt monitoring GPU provider and preserve atomic sample identity; keep raw rail/sensor names
Adapt TTO extraction/features/profile eligibility and reports
Replay preserved frames offline; verify existing Orin compatibility and failure paths
Install a separately identified candidate; rerun 180-second live doctor, workload/cooling collection and observed resource checks
